summary: Changes required. All four forest.yaml checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets) and the Revision fast-forwards master, but the deterministic eval harness is broken for the new critic case. evals/run-fast.sh validates every task with the Oracle agent, which runs solution/solve.sh (setup.py then reference.py); evals/runtime/reference.py maps critic_drafts to a no-op pass and creates no Powder jobs, while evals/runtime/grade.py requires 1-5 creates and at least one evidence note for critic_drafts. The critic-sweep-draft-only case therefore produces reward 0 and fails run-fast.sh. The oracle reference must create the draft jobs/notes (or the fast harness must not require absent oracle output). Also, agents/critic/skills/critic-sweep/SKILL.md hardcodes --repo misty-step/iron-forest in powder list/create even though the Critic is a shipped declaration that sweeps each repository's codebase; sibling declarations use the forest.yaml repo value, and the eval powder fixture never verifies --repo, so any non-iron-forest deployment would file drafts into the wrong repository.
